name: Winter Memories
source:
On a late afternoon in December, you meet up with your girlfriend for a walk through the snow.

While walking, you two bicker and exchange memories. Funny, embarrassing, everything... until you reach your destination...

[From [url=https://onioncuttingninja.itch.io/winter-memories]Itch.io[/url]]
